svg.title: Direct and portfolio evidence-to-dossier flows
svg.desc: A direct research-data capability calls one host SourcePort and returns one SourceBatch. An optional explicitly configured SourcePortfolioCollector calls at least two SourcePort routes and returns a SourcePortfolioReceipt while preserving separate batches, entitlements, attempts, and gaps. The caller derives terminal lineage from retained batches and declares decision-relevant gaps before StockResearchAgents performs domain-owned deterministic validation and completed-only publication.
